title: Port command guard configuration, identity and reset semantics
scope: Complete configureCommands, commandGuard and FREE guard over shared owned guard objects and synchronous fallible busy callbacks. Preserve object identity and unconditional cleanup reset, including old cleanup after a newer configuration.
acceptance: Full pinned activity module compares guard identity, callback returns/errors and reentrant configuration/reset order.
Dropping cleanup does not reset; opaque non-Clone callback faults and borrowed host lifetimes remain supported.
open_items: Activity running/progress state, plugin busy/watch/stop functions and full registry execution remain separate.
Owned guard objects exclude mutable JS busy-property getters/replacement and arbitrary prototype mutation.
